scope: Immutable read expected-fragment-count capture and propagation through the existing producer, allocation bridge, registry, and typed router. No read producer, endpoint payload deposition, source service, physical memory, timing, throughput, PPA, model/GPU, numeric RTL, or new A4 DSE behavior.

field.name: expected_fragment_count
field.semantic_use: validate accepted read fragment ordinal/last coverage and initialize an S2 fill without response-derived reconstruction

required_invariants: The allocation acknowledgement exactly echoes the bridge-captured expected_fragment_count before R2 exposure.
A registry-resolved read handoff preserves expected_fragment_count under ready-low backpressure.
Identity, target kind, target generation, release, and stale-incarnation rules apply to the complete allocation record.
No endpoint may reconstruct expected_fragment_count from a response, address, or candidate identifier.
explicitly_not_activated: S2 READY or direct-pending source deliverability
